title: Drop 01
subject: Opus 5.5
intro: A Drop runs a new model on the same setup. Here, Opus 5.5 runs against two baselines, Fable 5.1 and Opus 5, on five sealed briefs. Each model got one bare call per brief: no tools, no files, no memory. Below are the first attempts, unedited, shown as A, B and C. One of the three is the new model.
guess_line: Pick the new model on each brief, then reveal. The reveal also opens the verdicts, attempts #2 and #3, and the method.
record_question: Which one is the new model?
record_text_line: The opening of each page. Full pages in the gallery.
bar: Would I accept this as a first pass from a junior on my team?
